title: Los Angeles Luxury Private Tour For Up To 7 Passengers
includes: Transport by luxury air-conditioned SUV or bus (SUV for up to 7)
Free Hotel pickup and drop-off from hotels and addresses in the Los Angeles area
Tour guide gratuity is NOT included in the fare
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
Please note: The Observatory is closed on Mondays and the Park is sometimes closed for filming so as an alternative the tour may go to Mulholland Drive and/or The Hollywood Bowl
Please give us at least 48 hours advance notice if a wheelchair accessible vehicle is needed
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This 7 and a half hour private tour is a fantastic way to spend the day exploring Los Angeles, Venice Beach, Santa Monica, Beverly Hills and Hollywood. Your tour guide will narrate your day-long trip so you can pick up some facts and impress your friends and family members with your knowledge of the LA area. You’ll get to spend up to 45 minutes at every stop, so you can have a hands-on experience. This tour offers free hotel pickup and drop-off within the Los Angeles area. With over 3,500 5-Star reviews on TripAdvisor, Yelp and Google – you simply can’t go wrong!
